name: Jungle Secrets
summary: In northern Stranglethorn Vale, Private Thorsen explains why he rejoined Kurzen's men after you rescued him from an ambush. He sends you to the Rebel Camp to have his commander confirm the reason.

sections.title: A Covert Undertaking
sections.body: Private Thorsen says the scene looks grim and asks you to hear him out. Lieutenant Doren ordered him to re-enlist with Colonel Kurzen's men and gather desperately needed intelligence for the rebellion. Thorsen hoped this would let him enter Kurzen's Compound, but the effort soon went badly. He sends you to Doren at the Rebel Camp for confirmation and begs you to keep the matter secret.

sections.title: Suspicions at Camp
sections.body: Lieutenant Doren confirms that Private Thorsen acted on his orders. The rebels were once fiercely loyal to Kurzen, but corruption twisted that loyalty into rage. If Thorsen's dealings came to light, his own comrades would slit his throat. Only Doren, Sergeant Yohwa, and Thorsen were meant to know the plan. The failed ambush points to an unknown traitor among the rebels.

faq.q: Why was Private Thorsen meeting with Kurzen's forces?
faq.answer: Lieutenant Doren ordered Private Thorsen to re-enlist among Colonel Kurzen's men and gather vital military intelligence for the rebels.

faq.q: Where does Private Thorsen send you?
faq.answer: Private Thorsen sends you to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale, where his commander can confirm the story.

faq.q: Why does Thorsen insist on secrecy?
faq.answer: The rebels were once fiercely loyal to Colonel Kurzen. If they learned Thorsen had dealt with Kurzen's men, they could kill him in the night.

faq.q: What comes after reporting to Lieutenant Doren?
faq.answer: After you speak with Lieutenant Doren, your search leads to Bookie Herod.

angles.text: The Rebel Camp depends on the urgently needed intelligence Private Thorsen hopes to bring back from Kurzen's men.
